verdict.rationale: Direct probe evidence confirms an llms.txt file is live at docs.wandb.ai/llms.txt returning HTTP 200 with an index of documentation, plus per-page .md variants (e.g., weave.md) explicitly designed for agent consumption, and this is reinforced by an official MCP server and skills docs enabling agents to query W&B documentation directly. Missing for 10: independent third-party confirmation of agents successfully using llms.txt in practice.
